verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents undetected-browser and stealth modes for bypassing bot detection, plus persistent browser profiles with saved authentication states and session reuse. These help an agent get past bot walls and reuse logins, and JS execution could in principle drive forms. However, nothing shows automatic CAPTCHA solving or autonomous login/form completion. Missing for 10: CAPTCHA solving, automated login/form-fill flows without pre-saved auth, independent hands-on corroboration that bypass works.
